correctness.rationale: Nonzero squares have even p-adic valuation and square unit parts; Hensel lifting reduces their unit class to the Legendre symbol mod p. The disjoint shell decomposition gives K_k(t)=1+sum_m R_m(t). Orthogonality of p^(m-1) lifts makes R_m(t) zero below the boundary valuation, equal (p^(m-1)/2)(-1+chi(unit)T_p) on it, and equal |U_m| above it. Counting the exact +/- Legendre classes in each v gives the displayed J^+/J^- absolute-mass formula for every p,k. Convolution by normalized K has sharp l1 and linfty norm equal to its normalized absolute sum via point mass and phase-aligned witness. Two parity classes of v contribute geometric-series limits with summable errors, giving sigma_p*k+O_p(1). Independent direct Fourier sum of 463 coefficient values at small odd prime powers confirms the strata without substituting finite tests for Hensel/Gauss-sum proof.
